scenarios.scenario_abstract: Working from the suit color already fixed for the wedding party, [X] chooses a shirt and restrained supporting palette that fit the formal dress code, remain coherent across the group, and keep faces and tailoring distinct in photographs without competing with the couple's visual plan.
examples: using a light clean shirt for formal contrast
using a dark shirt only when the evening plan and group styling support it
using a softened neutral when a warmer ceremony palette needs less contrast
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 以婚礼团队已经确定的西装颜色为起点，[X]会选择符合正式着装要求的衬衫和克制配色，使全体成员在照片中保持协调、脸部与剪裁仍清晰可辨，同时不抢夺新人的视觉重心。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool cloudy day, [X] draws on limited styling experience to build an outfit around one owned thin bomber jacket, comparing base layers and trousers against that jacket in flat outdoor light and deciding whether to preserve a tonal look or introduce one controlled contrast near the face.
examples: keeping the owned jacket's source-supported dark color fixed
using a quiet base layer when comfort and simplicity matter
testing one small contrasting top or accessory rather than changing the familiar jacket
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在阴冷多云的一天，[X]虽然不熟悉穿搭，仍会围绕已有的一件轻薄飞行夹克搭配，在平淡的室外光线中比较内层和裤装与同一外套的关系，并决定保留同色调还是只在脸部附近加入一个受控对比。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an informal afternoon reunion on a familiar campus, [X] normally wears jeans and classic clogs and chooses a simple sweater, polo, or shirt color that looks intentional in daylight, works with dark denim, and raises the outfit one step without erasing a comfort-first habit.
examples: using a restrained neutral for an easy polished baseline
using a deeper color for clearer contrast against dark denim
using a brighter but solid top when the casual setting leaves room for personality
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加熟悉校园里的非正式午后同学聚会时，[X]平时爱穿牛仔裤和经典洞洞鞋，因此会选择一种在日光下显得有意识、能配深色牛仔且只把整体提升一步的简洁毛衣、Polo 衫或衬衫颜色，同时保留以舒适为先的习惯。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before trying on luxury eyeglass frames at an optometrist on a freezing afternoon, [X] chooses a plain knit or turtleneck near the face and a warm outer layer, judging the top color under daylight and shop lighting so it supports rather than masks the frames' metal, lens, and skin-tone effects.
examples: using a dark or cool top to expose warm metal contrast
using a light neutral to keep the face area open
using a muted colored knit only when it does not overpower the frames
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在寒冷午后去验光店试戴高端眼镜框前，[X]会选择靠近脸部的素色针织衫或高领上装并搭配保暖外层，在日光和店内灯光下判断上装颜色，使其衬托而不是掩盖镜架金属、镜片和肤色之间的效果。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping for a comfortable spring-and-autumn T-shirt to wear with jeans, [X] compares understated and livelier colors, uploads one specific candidate, and tests that same shirt with jeans, a cap, necklace, bag, outerwear, and seasonal layers before deciding whether to look for the remaining pieces.
examples: keeping the uploaded shirt's source-supported light color fixed
comparing quieter alternatives before the concrete candidate is evaluated
checking whether the exact shirt leaves room for one colored accessory without making the outfit busy
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 选购一件春秋季配牛仔裤、舒适又不过分张扬的 T 恤时，[X]会先比较低调与较活泼的颜色，随后上传一个具体候选，并用同一件 T 恤搭配牛仔裤、帽子、项链、包、外套和换季叠穿，最后决定是否去寻找其余单品。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For cool mornings and warmer afternoons, [X] builds one affordable capsule and assigns each short-sleeved top, long-sleeved top, button-down, cardigan, or jacket a color role based on repeated coordination, seasonal reuse, and whether layers still read clearly when opened, removed, or stacked.
examples: using a light button-down as a reusable visual bridge
using a dark or neutral long-sleeved base across more combinations
using one muted or fresh color when it can recur without breaking the capsule
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为凉爽清晨和温暖午后建立一套负担得起的胶囊衣橱时，[X]会根据重复搭配、跨季复用以及层次在敞开、脱下或叠加后是否仍清晰，为短袖、长袖、纽扣衫、开衫和外套分别确定颜色定位。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before using a washing machine, [X] sorts a real household load into white, light, bright, and dark groups, separates heavy garments from thin tops, turns printed and dark tops inside out, and watches which upper garments can safely share cold or warm cycles without dye transfer or visible fading.
examples: isolating white tops from darker dyes
combining compatible light or pastel tops when fabric weight also matches
protecting saturated and dark tops with cold washing and inside-out preparation
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在使用洗衣机前，[X]会把真实家庭衣物分成白色、浅色、鲜艳色和深色组，同时把厚重衣物与轻薄上装分开，将印花及深色上装翻面，并观察哪些上装能在冷水或温水程序中安全同洗而不串色或明显褪色。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While assembling a low-cost closet cosplay for Brock from ordinary clothing, [X] decides which upper-body colors are indispensable for instant character recognition and which vest, backpack, or accessory colors may bend when secondhand availability, comfort, and a fixed total budget matter more than canonical accuracy.
examples: preserving the character's source-supported warm shirt and green vest relationship
allowing supporting gear colors to vary when the silhouette still reads
prioritizing a recognizable two-color upper body before commissioning any piece
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 用普通服装低成本拼出 Brock 的日常衣橱 cosplay 时，[X]会判断哪些上半身颜色是让角色一眼可辨的关键，哪些背心、背包或配件颜色可以在二手可得性、舒适度和总预算比还原度更重要时灵活调整。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After uploading photographs of two previously worn outfits, [X] compares the same upper-body area as a continuous dark or neutral base and as a brighter interrupted layer, using perceived height, visual weight, waist placement, and repeated photo feedback rather than a generic slimming claim.
examples: retaining the photographed outfit's actual simple colors
testing a brighter fitted jacket as a controlled alternative rather than rewriting the photo
judging the color block together with waist and hem placement
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 上传两套近期真实穿过的搭配照片后，[X]会比较上半身保持连续深色或中性色基底，与加入较明亮合体层时的差异，并通过视觉身高、体量、腰线位置和多次照片反馈判断，而不是依赖笼统的显瘦说法。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For five days across Rome, Florence, and Venice with limited luggage, [X] assigns four or five light tops, one sweater, and one jacket a compact palette, checking how often each top can be reworn across churches, long walks, dinners, trains, changing weather, and visible stains before it earns suitcase space.
examples: using light and dark neutrals to maximize combinations
including one calm color that coordinates with every bottom and layer
rejecting a vivid top only when it cannot serve enough itinerary roles
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为期五天、途经罗马、佛罗伦萨和威尼斯且行李受限时，[X]会为四五件轻薄上装、一件毛衣和一件外套安排紧凑配色，并在教堂、长距离步行、晚餐、火车、天气变化和可见污渍等情境中检查每件上装能重复使用多少次，再决定是否让它占据行李空间。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A medical student whose hospital may assign uniform colors compares permitted scrub directions by patient approachability, perceived authority, role recognition, visible staining, and how a small personal badge accent reads during clinical rotations.
examples: following the hospital role code before personal taste
using a calm or authoritative shade when patient interaction is central
checking stain visibility and badge contrast over a full clinical day
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名可能受医院制服颜色规定约束的医学生，依据患者亲近感、权威感、角色识别、污渍可见度以及小型个性工牌在临床轮转中的呈现，比较允许范围内的手术服颜色方向。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A candidate preparing for a managerial interview at an industry organization chooses a suit and shirt palette that reads as steady leadership in person and on camera, remains compatible with the employer's formality, and avoids drawing attention away from evidence-based answers.
examples: using a light shirt under a restrained suit for clear face contrast
using a dark neutral only when lighting preserves separation
keeping bright color to a small accent when organizational representation is central
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名准备参加行业组织管理岗位面试的求职者，选择在线下和镜头中都能传达稳健领导感、符合雇主正式程度且不会让注意力偏离有证据回答的西装与衬衫配色。
